title: VaultAskEnvelopeV1
description: The `./vault ask --format json` answer envelope (spec 036 US1 / FR-003). Produced by research-framework, consumed by assistant-framework. Evolution follows ADR-0013: append-only within 1.x (additionalProperties stays true, new fields are optional), a new schema file per major, `schema_version` carried in the payload so a consumer can refuse a major it does not know. No producer exists yet (036 T001); this file is the contract the producer will conform to, not a description of its output.

schema_version.description: The envelope's version, `<major>.<minor>`. This schema accepts every 1.x payload and refuses any other major (ADR-0013 §2-§3).

answer.description: The vault-first answer as Markdown. Empty string when the vault cannot answer (spec 036 FR-006) — never omitted.

citations.description: Tier-1 citations (Principle IX): the vault notes the answer rests on. Empty only when `answer` is empty.

confidence.description: The producer's confidence in [0, 1]. `0.0` with `low_confidence_reason` when it could not be computed (spec 036 US1 scenario 4).

source_urls.description: Tier-2 citations: the external URLs the Tier-1 notes de-reference to. Optional.

cost_usd.description: What producing this answer cost, from the dispatch sidecar (spec 028 / 078). Optional; absent when the runtime reported nothing.

low_confidence_reason.description: Why `confidence` is low or zero, e.g. `no relevant notes found`. Optional; expected whenever `confidence` is 0.0.

note_path.description: Vault-relative path of the cited note, e.g. `data_vault/concepts/<note>.md`.

snippet.description: The passage the answer draws on, verbatim from the note.
